name: Ryan W. Smith
biography: (@ryanwsmith13) is a Senior Research and Response Engineer at Lookout, and has been an actively making and breaking software systems for the past 11 years. With a tendency to jump into anything sufficiently interesting and challenging, his projects range from automated x86 reverse engineering to large scale network attack graph analytics. As a chronic community contributor, Ryan may have been seen speaking at any number of Honynet Project, OWASP, AHA, or UT COMSOC events.
